$description: What a PageSpec may reference and what is enforced. PageSpec nodes may carry an optional tokens{} object; every value must be a catalog token id of the category its field allows. Raw values are never allowed. Rule ids are implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py; the category keys below are real keys of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json#/categories (checked by extraction/verify_all.py).

themeCombinations.evidence: tokens/10-semantic/semantic.json light/dark resolution + data-nav-theme section themes in the clone

restrictedTokens.font.family.pattern-mono: only the ASCII canvas in the light footer

rawValueRestrictions.color: No raw hex / rgb() / hsl() / named colours anywhere in node tokens or content style fields (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR).
rawValueRestrictions.semanticColor: Use semantic ids, never the foundation colour they resolve to.
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: No raw px/rem/em spacing values (TOKEN_RAW_SPACING); spacing roles only.
rawValueRestrictions.spacingRole: paddingY uses space.section-y.*, gap uses space.gap.*.

conventions: Section contracts own layout and typography; nodes only nudge surface/text/spacing within these rules.
Breakpoint and motion tokens are referenced by contracts and motion-patterns.json, not by PageSpec nodes.
